αὐτόθ: αὐτόθι — right there, on the spot; adv., elided (αὐτόθ’ = αὐτόθι)
βοὸς: βοῦς — ox, cow, heifer; gen. sg.
γρηῒ: γρηῦς — old woman; fem. dat. sg., epic (= Attic γραΐ, from γραῦς)
δαίμων: δαίμων — a god, some divine power (vague, unspecified); masc. nom. sg.
δαμεὶς: δάμνημι — subdue, overcome; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’overcome’
δολοφρονέουσα: δολοφρονέω — plot craftily, think guile; pres. part. fem. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic δολοφρονοῦσα)
δύνατο: δύναμαι — be able, can; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐδύνατο)
εἴη: εἰμί — be; pres. opt. 3 sg.: ’it might be, he might be’; impersonal + inf.: ’it might be possible for him’ · also in a wish with a dat. of the person: ’may there be (for us)’ (εἴη μὲν νῦν νῶϊν … ἐδωδὴ ’may there be food for us two’) · also in a wish after εἰ γάρ, ’if only (all things) were’ · also in a fear clause after μή, ’lest it be (a god)’ · also in a conditional protasis: ’if he were’ (εἰ τοιόσδ’ εἴη) · also in an indirect question after a past verb: ’who he was’ (τίς εἴη) · also in a negative wish with μή, ’may (no man) be’ · also potential opt. with κε in a relative clause, ’which would be’ (τό κε κέρδιον εἴη ’which would be better’) · also in a wish after αἲ γάρ, with a perf. pass. part.: ’would that it were (fulfilled)’ (αἲ γὰρ … τετελεσμένον εἴη) · also pres. opt. 3 sg. in a relative clause standing for a condition: ’(a man) who were’ (ὅς τ’ ἄλκιμος εἴη ’one who were valiant’)
εἴρια: εἴριον (εἶρος) — wool, fleece; neut. acc. pl.
εἵπετ: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (εἵπετ’ = εἵπετο), augmented with a doubled vowel: ’followed’
εἷσ: ἵζω (aor. εἷσα) — seat, set, place; aor. 3 sg. act., elided (εἷσ’ = εἷσε): ’he set’
εὔχε: εὔχομαι — pray, vow; pres. imper. mid. 2 sg., elided (εὔχεο → εὔχε’): ’pray!’
θαλάμῳ: θάλαμος — inner room, bedchamber; masc. dat. sg.
κέλομαι: κέλομαι — bid, order, urge; pres. 1 sg.
κίε: κίω — go, go one’s way; aor. 3 sg. (root aorist, unaugmented): ’went’ (the gen. Τηλεμάχοιο is governed by ἰθύς ’straight toward’, not by this verb) · also imper. 2 sg.: ’go!’
καλά: καλός — good, fine, beautiful; neut. nom./acc. pl.
κατέθηκε: κατατίθημι — put down, put away, store; aor. 3 sg. (κ-aorist) ’put away’ · also ’set down, lay out’ (prizes for a contest); aor. 3 sg.
κείνου: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); masc. gen. sg.
κελεύθου: κέλευθος — way, road, journey, voyage; gen. sg.
κεῖθι: κεῖθι — there; adv., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖ)
κεῖνον: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); masc. acc. sg.
κεῖσε: κεῖσε — to that place, thither; adv.
κηρὶ: κήρ — death, doom allotted to a person; fem. dat. sg.
κιών: κίω — go; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic (cf. Attic ἰών): ’going’
λάθεν: λανθάνω — escape the notice of (+ acc.); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔλαθεν)
λέχεσσι: λέχος — bed, couch; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
λαβοῦσα: λαμβάνω — take, seize; aor. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’having taken (me in)’
λεχέεσσιν: λέχος — bed, couch; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι, plural for a single bed
λιλαίεαι: λιλαίομαι — long for, desire eagerly; pres. 2 sg., uncontracted (= Attic λιλαίῃ): ’you long’
λυγρὰ: λυγρός — grievous, baneful, miserable; neut. acc. pl. (grave, mid-clause form): ’grievous things’
μενεαίνων: μενεαίνω — be furious, rage; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
μενελάου: Μενέλαος — Menelaus, king of Sparta, brother of Agamemnon; masc. gen. sg.
νεμεσσητὸν: νεμεσσητός — open to righteous blame; neut. nom. sg., predicate (οὔ τι νεμεσσητόν): ’no cause for resentment’
νόησε: νοέω — perceive, notice; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐνόησε): ’noticed’
οἶτον: οἶτος — fate, doom (usually evil); masc. acc. sg.
πάρα: παρά — beside; πάρα (accent drawn back) stands for πάρεστι/πάρεισι ’is/are at hand, present’ · also prep. placed after its noun (anastrophe) · also adv. after its verb (anastrophe): ἐτίθει πάρα ’set beside’ (= παρετίθει)
πάσας: πᾶς — all, every; fem. acc. pl., substantival: ’all of them’ (the seals) · also fem. acc. pl., plain attributive adj. agreeing with a noun: πάσας … ἀέλλας ’all the blasts’
παχείῃ: παχύς — thick, stout, strong; fem. dat. sg., epic -είῃ (= Attic παχείᾳ)
παύεσθαι: παύω — stop; mid. cease, leave off (+ gen.); pres. inf. mid.
περικαλλέ: περικαλλής — very beautiful; masc. acc. sg., elided (περικαλλέ’ = περικαλλέα) · also neut. acc./nom. dual, elided (περικαλλέ’ = περικαλλέε), with ὄσσε: ’the two very fair (eyes)’ · also neut. acc. pl., elided (περικαλλέ’ = περικαλλέα), agreeing with ἄεθλα: ’very beautiful (prizes)’
ποιήσεται: ποιέω — make, do; mid. make for oneself; fut. 3 sg. mid. (or short-vowel aor. subj.) with κεν: ’will make’, with a double acc.
πολλῇ: πολύς — much, many; fem. dat. sg.: ’great’
προκάλεσσαι: προκαλέω — call forth, challenge, invite; aor. imper. 2 sg. mid., epic -σσαι (= προκάλεσαι): ’challenge’
προτέρω: πρότερος — before, further; neut. comp. adv. προτέρω: ’further in’
πόδεσσιν: πούς — foot; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic ποσί)
στήθεά: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. nom./acc. pl., uncontracted (= Attic στήθη)
στίλβων: στίλβω — gleam, glisten; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’glistening’
στυγερὴν: στυγερός — hateful, loathsome; adj., fem. acc. sg.
σχετλίη: σχέτλιος — hard-hearted, obdurate, wretched; fem. nom. sg., epic -η (= Attic -α)
σῇ: σός — your, yours; fem. dat. sg.
τέτατο: τείνω — stretch, extend; plpf. pass. 3 sg.: ’was stretched out’
τοὔνεκα: τοὔνεκα (crasis of τοῦ ἕνεκα) — for this reason, therefore; adv.
τραπείομεν: τρέπω — turn; aor. pass. subj. 1 pl., epic lengthened (= Attic τραπῶμεν), hortatory: ’let us turn’
τρητοῖσι: τρητός — bored, pierced (of a bedstead strung through drilled holes); neut. dat. pl.
τρῳαὶ: Τρῳαί — the Trojan women; fem. nom. pl. (feminine of Τρῶες)
φέρουσα: φέρω — carry, bear; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’carrying, bringing’
φέρτερος: φέρτερος — stronger, better; comparative of ἀγαθός, masc. nom. sg., predicate
φαίνετ: φαίνω — show; mid. appear; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (φαίνετ’ = φαίνετο): ’was appearing’ · also φαίνω, mid. pres. 3 sg., elided (φαίνετ’ = φαίνεται): ’appears, shows itself’
φαεινῷ: φαεινός — shining, bright, radiant; masc./neut. dat. sg.
φιλέεσκε: φιλέω — love, be fond of; impf. 3 sg., iterative in -σκ- (unaugmented): ’used to be fond of’
φύλασσε: φυλάσσω — keep watch, guard; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐφύλασσε): ’was keeping watch’
χαλεποῖσιν: χαλεπός — harsh, difficult, severe; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οῖς)
χορὸν: χορός — dance; dancing-place; masc. acc. sg.
ἀμειβόμενος: ἀμείβομαι — answer, reply; pres. part. masc. nom. sg. mid.
ἀμφεκάλυψεν: ἀμφικαλύπτω — cover round about, envelop; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’covered over’
ἀν: ἀνά (elided ἀν’) — up, along; prep. + acc.: ἀν’ ἰθύν ’in a straight line’ · also + acc., ’throughout, up and down’ (ἀν’ Ἑλλάδα ’throughout Hellas’)
ἀργῆτι: ἀργής — bright, vivid white, gleaming; masc. dat. sg., of the lightning-flash (distinct root from ἀργός)
ἄγεσθαι: ἄγω — lead, carry off; pres. inf. mid.: ’to carry off for oneself’
ἄκριτα: ἄκριτος — endless, undistinguished, confused; neut. acc. pl. used as a cognate object or adverbially
ἄλοχον: ἄλοχος — wife, one who shares the bed; acc. sg.
ἄξεις: ἄγω — lead, bring; fut. 2 sg.: ’you will bring’
ἐκάλυψε: καλύπτω — cover, veil, enshroud; aor. 3 sg.
ἐνόησε: νοέω — perceive, think, devise; aor. 3 sg.
ἐοικὼς: ἔοικα — be like, resemble (+ dat.); perf. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’like’
ἐπιδινήσας: ἐπιδινέω — whirl round; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having whirled’
ἐπόρουσε: ἐπορούω — rush upon, spring upon (+ dat.); aor. 3 sg.
ἐρίηρες: ἐρίηρος — trusty, dear (of companions; exact sense uncertain); masc. nom. pl.
ἔπλεον: πλέω — sail; impf. 3 pl.: ’they were sailing, they sailed’
ἕλκε: ἕλκω — drag, pull; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= εἷλκε)
ἠέρι: ἀήρ — mist, haze; masc. dat. sg., epic ἠέρι, of means: ’in mist’
ἤλυθες: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 2 sg., epic ἤλυθες (= Attic ἦλθες): ’you came’
ἤρατο: ἄρνυμαι — win, gain, achieve; aor. mid. 3 sg., augmented (α lengthens to η): ’endured, won (his toils)’
ἰοῦσα: εἶμι — go; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.
ἱμάντα: ἱμάς — strap, thong (esp. of a door-latch); masc. acc. sg.
ἱμερόεντα: ἱμερόεις — lovely, charming, arousing longing (ἵμερος ’longing’); neut. acc. pl. (with ἔπεα) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with χορόν: ’full of longing, lovely’ (χορὸν ἱμερόεντα)
ἴδοιτο: ὁράω — see; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., potential with κε: ’would see’
ἴε: εἶμι — go; impf. 3 sg., epic ἴε (= Attic ᾔει): ’went’
ἵμερος: ἵμερος — longing, desire; masc. nom. sg.
ὀλέσθαι: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish, be lost; aor. mid. inf.
ὤφελες: ὀφείλω — owe; aor. 2 sg., in an unfulfilled wish + inf.: ’you ought to have, I wish you had’
ᾔνεον: αἰνέω — praise, approve; impf. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ᾔνουν), in tmesis with ἐπί: ’they approved’
